title: Best Builds in Expedition 33
description: Top character builds for Expedition 33. Optimal Pictos, weapons, and skill setups for Maelle, Verso, Lune and more.

sections.title: Build System Overview
sections.content: Builds in Expedition 33 revolve around three pillars: equipped Pictos (passive abilities), weapon choice, and skill point allocation. Each character has a unique skill tree with branching paths. You can respec at any Chronos Stone for a small Paint cost. The meta favors builds that maximize parry windows and counter damage, but pure DPS and support builds are viable for different team compositions.

sections.title: Current Top Builds (Patch 1.2)
sections.content:
1. Counter-Strike Maelle — Stack parry-damage Pictos with the Obsidian Greatsword for massive counter hits. Best for boss fights.
2. Tempo Healer Verso — Rhythm-based healing build using the Conductor's Baton. Heals scale with perfect timing chains.
3. Sniper Lune — Maximum range build with Piercing Shot Pictos. Melts single targets from safety.
4. Hybrid Gustave — Tank/support with aggro generation and party shields. Essential for harder difficulties.

sections.title: Pictos Priority Guide
sections.content: When building any character, prioritize Pictos in this order: 1) Core mechanic enhancers (parry window, timing bonus), 2) Damage multipliers (crit rate, elemental damage), 3) Survivability (HP%, damage reduction), 4) Utility (movement speed, Paint generation). Rare Pictos from boss drops are generally stronger than found ones. The Tier List page ranks all Pictos by effectiveness.
